name: Action Item Tracker
description: Metabase dashboard for Action Item Tracker

native.query: SELECT task_desc as title, owner_id as assignee_id, due_date, booking_id as meeting_id FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_action_items WHERE status = 'PENDING' AND due_date < CURRENT_DATE ORDER BY due_date

SELECT owner_id as assignee_id, CASE WHEN COUNT(*) > 0 THEN COUNT(CASE WHEN status='COMPLETED' THEN 1 END)*100/COUNT(*) ELSE 0 END as completion_pct FROM {{TENANT_SCHEMA}}.meeting_action_items GROUP BY owner_id ORDER BY completion_pct DESC
